title: 现在完成时 vs 过去完成时

examples.zh: 我写完作业了（现在写完了）。

examples.en: I had finished my homework before my mother came back.
examples.zh: 妈妈回来之前我就写完作业了。

guess.question: 两句都是“写完作业”，参照点有什么不同？

options.text: 第一句以“现在”为参照，第二句以“过去的某个时刻”为参照
options.feedback: 对！参照点是现在用 have/has，参照点是过去用 had。
不对——快慢不是判据，参照点才是。
不对——一个说“到现在为止”，一个说“到过去某时为止”。

left.label: 现在完成时
left.focus: 以“现在”为参照点：到现在为止已经完成

right.label: 过去完成时

anchor.en: I had finished my homework before Mum came back.
anchor.zh: 妈妈回来前我就写完了。

right.focus: 以“过去的某个时刻”为参照点：到那时为止已经完成

contrast.diff: 句子里有没有一个“过去的时间点”当参照？没有 → 现在完成时（have/has）；有（when I got there / before he came / by the time…）→ 过去完成时（had）。

traps.wrong: I have finished my homework before he came.
traps.right: I had finished my homework before he came.
traps.why: before he came 是过去参照点，要用 had。

traps.wrong: He had lived here for ten years.
traps.right: He has lived here for ten years.
traps.why: 句子里没有过去参照点，说的是“到现在住了十年”，用 has。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——判断口诀：找参照点，有过去时间点用 had，没有就用 have/has。

check.stem: We ____ (learn) 500 words by the end of last term.

options.distractor: last term 是过去参照点
“到上学期末为止”要用过去完成时

check.explanation: “到上学期末为止”是过去参照点，用 had learned。

check.stem: — Are you free now? — Yes, I ____ (finish) my work.

options.distractor: 这里没有过去参照点，说的是“现在已经做完了”
强调对现在的影响（现在有空），用完成时

check.explanation: 参照点是“现在”，用 have finished。

options.text: She had cleaned the room when her friend arrived.
She has cleaned the room when her friend arrived.
options.distractor: arrived 是过去参照点，要用 had

options.text: She had clean the room when her friend arrived.
options.distractor: had 后面要接过去分词

options.text: She was clean the room when her friend arrived.

check.explanation: 朋友到达（过去参照点）之前她就打扫完了，用 had cleaned。
